title: test
description: Stage output contract: tests run + the test-validate self-report (the 'verify' half). tests_meaningful is required so a codex runner that omits it is a SCHEMA_VIOLATION (the schema-enforced form of the engine's fail-open gate); null is the explicit 'I could not judge this' answer a runner that cannot judge meaningfulness must give instead of a fake true (#261).

failures.description: ids of failing tests (empty when green)

tests_meaningful.description: true only if the tests genuinely exercise the change (would fail if it regressed); false if they do not (the engine vetoes the stage). null means NO verdict was reached — the runner could not judge meaningfulness (the deterministic ENGINE lane cannot, #261). A boolean is a real judgment; null is an honest abstention (fail-OPEN, and evented as test_validation_skipped when REVIEW abstains too). Omitting the key entirely is still a contract violation.

validation_notes.description: what the tests assert / any gaps

change_class.description: #41: deterministic change classification from the git diff (base_sha..worktree). Set ONLY by the ENGINE-lane runner — a model claim here is ignored at the context fold. 'docs-only' relaxes downstream test-coverage criteria and short-circuits this stage to an honest skip.

skipped.description: #41: reason this stage was short-circuited without running the suite (e.g. 'docs-only'). Present only on a skip; never a faked green run — 'passed' means 'nothing to fail'.
